en.description: How well do you care for your body and energy? Think about your sleep, movement, food, and how often you feel truly alive in it.
en.name: Health & Wellbeing

en.description: Do you feel connected and supported? Consider how your friendships, family, and love life actually feel, not how they look.
en.name: Relationships

en.description: Does your work give you a sense of direction or pride? Are you creating something that matters to you — or just filling the hours?
en.name: Career & Purpose

en.description: How safe and stable do you feel around money? Not just income, but freedom — the ability to make choices without fear.
en.name: Finances & Security

en.description: Are you evolving, learning, becoming wiser? Think of curiosity, creativity, and the joy of discovering new parts of yourself.
en.name: Personal Growth & Learning

en.description: Do you allow yourself to pause, play, and breathe? Life isn’t meant to be all progress — it’s also recovery and delight.
en.name: Leisure, Fun & Rest

en.description: Do you feel that what you do adds something good to the world? Even small acts count if they make you feel useful and kind.
en.name: Social Contribution

en.description: How connected do you feel to something larger than yourself — or simply to your own thoughts? This is the quiet space where meaning lives.
en.name: Spirituality
